new.md:
Creates a new slice model.

It presents the slice from `offset` to offset + `size`
of the given `model`.

doc.brief: A list model that presents a slice of another model.
doc.md:
A list model that presents a slice of another model.

This is useful when implementing paging by setting the size to the number
of elements per page and updating the offset whenever a different page is
opened.

`GtkSliceListModel` passes through sections from the underlying model.

get_model.brief: Gets the model that is currently being used or `NULL` if none.
get_model.md: Gets the model that is currently being used or `NULL` if none.

get_offset.brief: Gets the offset set via gtk_slice_list_model_set_offset().
get_offset.md: Gets the offset set via gtk_slice_list_model_set_offset().

get_size.brief: Gets the size set via gtk_slice_list_model_set_size().
get_size.md: Gets the size set via gtk_slice_list_model_set_size().

set_model.brief: Sets the model to show a slice of.
set_model.md:
Sets the model to show a slice of.

The model's item type must conform to `self`'s item type.

set_offset.brief: Sets the offset into the original model for this slice.
set_offset.md:
Sets the offset into the original model for this slice.

If the offset is too large for the sliced model,
`self` will end up empty.

set_size.md:
Sets the maximum size. `self` will never have more items
than `size`.

It can however have fewer items if the offset is too large
or the model sliced from doesn't have enough items.

model.brief: Child model to take slice from.
model.md: Child model to take slice from.
